comment: SyncEQ - EQ and tone shaping that also passes Mozaic's bar sync on to the effects in later slots, for synths and drum machines. LoCut and HiCut trim the ends, Low/Mid/High boost or cut (Mid has its own frequency), Drive adds soft saturation, Level sets the output. Tempo is the BPM: put SyncEQ in slots 1-3 and let Mozaic flip its Tempo, and every synced effect after it stays on the bar. Only needed when no tempo effect sits in slots 1-3.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 493 Breather, 494 SyncEQ (this pack; 492 was used by a dropped effect). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: LoCut
params.comment: High-pass filter, 12 dB per octave. OFF, then 20 Hz to 500 Hz. Default OFF.

params.name: Low
params.comment: Bass shelf at 100 Hz, -12 to +12 dB. Default 0 (flat).

params.name: Mid
params.comment: Mid bell at MidF, -12 to +12 dB. Default 0 (flat).

params.name: MidF
params.comment: Frequency of the Mid bell, 200 Hz to 5 kHz. Default 1.0k.

params.name: High
params.comment: Treble shelf at 8 kHz, -12 to +12 dB. Default 0 (flat).

params.name: HiCut
params.comment: Low-pass filter, 12 dB per octave. 1 kHz to 20 kHz, then OFF. Default OFF.

params.name: Drive
params.comment: Soft saturation after the EQ. 0 = clean, 100 = warm and squashed. The output is turned down as Drive goes up so the level stays close.

params.name: Tempo
params.comment: BPM sent to the effects after SyncEQ (40 to 240), shown on screen. Flipping to the twin copy of the same BPM (120 <-> 321) marks a new bar for them: Mozaic's bar sync does that on each downbeat. SYNC: the knob runs 0..441 and holds every BPM twice: 241..441 is a twin copy (BPM = screen - 201, so past 240 the screen shows 40 again). Default 120.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
